@concat('"Begin

update AGP.Receipts_BillingGroupID_Lookup lkp 
set lkp.MEME_RECORD_NO =(select DISTINCT  meme_record_no from cmc_meme_member mem 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG mepe on mem.meme_ck = mepe.meme_ck
JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEMD_MECR_DETL memd on mepe.meme_ck = memd.meme_ck
join FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON GRGR.GRGR_CK =MEM.GRGR_CK AND (grgr.GRGR_ID LIKE ''%MCR%'' OR grgr.GRGR_ID LIKE ''%PDP%'')
WHERE memd.MEME_HICN = lkp.acctnum AND memd.MEMD_EVENT_CD = ''HICN'' AND lkp.receiveddate between MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND mepe.mepe_term_dt
AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND =''Y'' AND meme_record_no <> '' '' and rownum=1);

update AGP.Receipts_BillingGroupID_Lookup lkp 
set lkp.MEME_RECORD_NO =(select DISTINCT  meme_record_no from cmc_meme_member mem 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG mepe on mem.meme_ck = mepe.meme_ck
JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEMD_MECR_DETL memd on mepe.meme_ck = memd.meme_ck
join FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON GRGR.GRGR_CK =MEM.GRGR_CK AND (grgr.GRGR_ID LIKE ''%MCR%'' OR grgr.GRGR_ID LIKE ''%PDP%'')
WHERE memd.MEME_HICN = lkp.acctnum
AND memd.MEMD_EVENT_CD = ''HICN''
AND mepe.mepe_term_dt > TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('gv_MPWRDate')), '"'', ''mm/dd/yyyy HH:MI:SS AM'')
AND mepe.mepe_eff_dt <= lkp.receiveddate
AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND =''Y'' AND meme_record_no <> '' '' AND rownum=1)
WHERE (lkp.MEME_RECORD_NO is null OR lkp.MEME_RECORD_NO='''');

update AGP.Receipts_BillingGroupID_Lookup lkp 
set lkp.SBSB_ID =(select DISTINCT  sbsb.sbsb_id from cmc_meme_member mem
                          JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG mepe on mem.meme_ck = mepe.meme_ck
                          JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEMD_MECR_DETL memd on mepe.meme_ck = memd.meme_ck
                          JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = mem.SBSB_CK
                          JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK AND (grgr.GRGR_ID LIKE ''%MCR%'' OR grgr.GRGR_ID LIKE ''%PDP%'')
                          Where memd.MEME_HICN = lkp.acctnum  
                          AND memd.MEMD_EVENT_CD = ''HICN''
                          AND lkp.receiveddate between MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND mepe.mepe_term_dt
                          AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND =''Y'' AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE ''%MCR%'' AND rownum=1)
                                                                                                  WHERE lkp.MEME_RECORD_NO is null OR lkp.MEME_RECORD_NO='' '';

update AGP.Receipts_BillingGroupID_Lookup lkp 
set lkp.SBSB_ID =(select DISTINCT  sbsb.sbsb_id from cmc_meme_member mem 
                          JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG mepe ON mem.meme_ck = mepe.meme_ck
                          JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEMD_MECR_DETL memd on mepe.meme_ck = memd.meme_ck
                          JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = mem.SBSB_CK
                          JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK AND (grgr.GRGR_ID LIKE ''%MCR%'' OR grgr.GRGR_ID LIKE ''%PDP%'')
                          Where memd.MEME_HICN = lkp.acctnum
                          AND memd.MEMD_EVENT_CD = ''HICN''  
                          AND mepe.mepe_term_dt > TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('gv_MPWRDate')), '"'', ''mm/dd/yyyy HH:MI:SS AM'')
                          AND mepe.mepe_eff_dt <= lkp.receiveddate
                          AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND =''Y'' AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE ''%MCR%'' AND rownum=1)
                                                                                                  WHERE (lkp.MEME_RECORD_NO is null OR lkp.MEME_RECORD_NO='' '') and (lkp.sbsb_id is null or sbsb_id ='''');

set lkp.SBSB_ID = substr(lkp.acctnum,1,9), lkp.VendorRefId = lkp.acctnum
where (lkp.MEME_RECORD_NO is null OR lkp.MEME_RECORD_NO='' '');

end;"')

@concat('"Select curBatch.BatchId,curBatch.ReceiptId, curBatch.VendorRefId,prvBatch.FACReceiptId, prvBatch.ReceiptId as PrvReceiptID 
from Receipts.Receipt (nolock)  curBatch

JOIN  Receipts.Receipt prvBatch (nolock)
on ISNULL(prvBatch.VendorRefId,'''')=ISNULL(curBatch.VendorRefId,'''')
AND prvBatch.PaymentType=''P'' 
AND prvBatch.FACReceiptId IS NOT NULL 
AND curBatch.VendorRefId IS NOT NULL

AND  curBatch.BatchId <> prvBatch.BatchId

AND  curBatch.BatchId=  "', string(variables('BatchId')), '"
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM Receipts.Receipt (nolock) R

WHERE ISNULL(prvBatch.VendorRefId,'''')=ISNULL(R.VendorRefId,'''') 
AND prvBatch.VendorRefId IS NOT NULL
AND prvBatch.PaymentType=R.PaymentType
AND prvBatch.FACReceiptId=R.FACReceiptId
AND R.BatchId <> "', string(variables('BatchId')), '"
Having prvBatch.ReceiptId= Max(R.ReceiptId))
"')

@concat('"INSERT INTO [Receipts].[FacetsNSFStage]
select curBatch.BatchId,curBatch.ReceiptId, curBatch.VendorRefId,
prvBatch.FACReceiptId , prvBatch.ReceiptId as PrvReceiptID,''S'' AS ExcludeInd
from Receipts.Receipt  curBatch
JOIN  Receipts.Receipt prvBatch 
on prvBatch.VendorRefId=curBatch.VendorRefId 
AND prvBatch.PaymentType=''P''

AND  curBatch.BatchId != prvBatch.BatchId
AND  curBatch.BatchId= "', string(variables('BatchId')), '"
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM Receipts.Receipt R
				WHERE prvBatch.VendorRefId=R.VendorRefId
AND prvBatch.PaymentType=R.PaymentType

AND R.FACReceiptId IS NULL
AND R.BatchId !="', string(variables('BatchId')), '"

			)
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM  Receipts.FacetsNSFStage R
				WHERE R.BatchId=curBatch.BatchId
				AND R.ReceiptId=curBatch.ReceiptId)
"')

@concat('MERGE INTO ', variables('gv_ReceiptNSFLookup'), '" rnp 
USING ( 
select  /*+ optimizer_features_enable(''11.2.0.3'') */ DISTINCT NSF.FACReceiptId
from AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_NSF_LOOKUP NSF
JOIN FACETS.CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS a ON a.RCPT_ID=NSF.FACReceiptId
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLRC_BILL_RCPT b on a.RCPT_ID = b.RCPT_ID
JOIN FACETS.CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS c on b.BLRC_ALLOC_RCPT_ID = c.RCPT_ID
WHERE A.RCPT_INPUT_GRGR_ID LIKE ''%WP0'' 
and a.BLEI_CK = b.BLEI_CK
and c.RCPT_RCPT_CD IN (''F'', ''O'',''W'',''Z'',''R'',''N'',''X'')
) ta 
ON (ta.FACReceiptId=rnp.FACReceiptId) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET rnp.ExcludeInd=''F''"')

gv_OracleLookup_Update.value: 'Begin MERGE INTO AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP rcp  USING ( sELECT /*+ optimizer_features_enable('11.2.0.3') */ distinct r.PAYMENT_TYPE,sbsb.sbsb_ck AS sub_ck, SBSB.SBSB_ID as subscriberID, grgr.grgr_id AS GroupId,               CASE WHEN sbsb.sbsb_ck = per.sbsb_ck AND r.PAYMENT_TYPE = 'P' THEN 'L' END AS PAYMENT_BILLINGLEVEL,               CASE WHEN sbsb.sbsb_ck = per.sbsb_ck AND r.PAYMENT_TYPE = 'F' THEN MAX(PER.BLBP_BILL_PER) END AS REFUND_BILLINGLEVEL       FROM  AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP r        JOIN Facets.cmc_sbsb_subsc sbsb ON r.sbsb_id=sbsb.sbsb_id         LEFT JOIN facets.CMC_BLBP_BILL_PER per ON sbsb.sbsb_ck= per.sbsb_ck  and sbsb.grgr_ck = per.grgr_ck       AND r.receiveddate = (SELECT MAX(receiveddate) FROM AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP WHERE SBSB_ID = R.SBSB_ID)          JOIN Facets.cmc_grgr_group grgr on sbsb.grgr_ck = grgr.grgr_ck  AND grgr.grgr_id = 'INMCDWP0'        JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER meme on sbsb.sbsb_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK        JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG mepe on meme.meme_ck = mepe.meme_ck         AND r.receiveddate between LEAST(r.receiveddate,MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT) AND mepe.mepe_term_dt       AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND ='Y'      GROUP BY  per.sbsb_ck,sbsb.sbsb_ck,SBSB.SBSB_ID,grgr.grgr_id,per.sbsb_ck,r.PAYMENT_TYPE             UNION              SELECT distinct  r.PAYMENT_TYPE,sbsb.sbsb_ck AS sub_ck, SBSB.SBSB_ID as subscriberID, grgr.grgr_id AS GroupId,'' PAYMENT_BILLINGLEVEL,0   AS REFUND_BILLINGLEVEL        FROM  AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP r        JOIN Facets.cmc_sbsb_subsc sbsb ON r.sbsb_id=sbsb.sbsb_id         AND r.receiveddate = (SELECT MAX(receiveddate) FROM AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP WHERE SBSB_ID = R.SBSB_ID)          JOIN Facets.cmc_grgr_group grgr on sbsb.grgr_ck = grgr.grgr_ck  AND grgr.grgr_id in (select distinct (grgr_id) from agp.boss_invoice_lookup where grgr_id not in 'INMCDWP0' )         JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER meme on sbsb.sbsb_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK        JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG mepe on meme.meme_ck = mepe.meme_ck         AND r.receiveddate between LEAST(r.receiveddate,MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT) AND CASE WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' THEN  MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT + INTERVAL '31' DAY ELSE MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT END       AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND ='Y'               UNION                 SELECT  distinct r.PAYMENT_TYPE,sa.sbsb_ck AS sub_ck, SA.SAMI_ALT_ID AS subscriberID,grgr.grgr_id AS GroupId,'' PAYMENT_BILLINGLEVEL,0   AS REFUND_BILLINGLEVEL       FROM AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP r       JOIN AGP.SAMI SA ON r.sbsb_id = sa.SAMI_ALT_ID       AND r.receiveddate = (SELECT MAX(receiveddate) FROM AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP WHERE SBSB_ID = R.SBSB_ID)        JOIN Facets.cmc_grgr_group grgr ON sa.grgr_ck = grgr.grgr_ck AND grgr.grgr_id LIKE '%SUP%'       JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER meme ON sa.sbsb_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK       JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG mepe ON meme.meme_ck = mepe.meme_ck        AND r.receiveddate between LEAST(r.receiveddate,MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT) AND  MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT + INTERVAL '31' DAY                                       AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND ='Y'           )ta              ON (ta.subscriberID=rcp.sbsb_id and ta.payment_type=rcp.payment_type)       WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET rcp.SBSB_CK=ta.sub_ck,        rcp.GRGR_ID = ta.GroupId,        rcp.PAYMENT_BILLINGLEVEL = ta.PAYMENT_BILLINGLEVEL,        rcp.REFUND_BILLINGLEVEL = ta.REFUND_BILLINGLEVEL;  end;'

BEGIN
MERGE INTO AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP RCP 
USING (
SELECT  /*+ optimizer_features_enable('11.2.0.3') */ DISTINCT R.PAYMENT_TYPE,SBSB.SBSB_CK AS SUB_CK, SBSB.SBSB_ID AS SUBSCRIBERID, GRGR.GRGR_ID AS GROUPID,
                CASE WHEN SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLBP.SBSB_CK THEN BLBP_BILL_PER END AS REFUND_BILLINGLEVEL
     FROM  AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP R 
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON R.SBSB_ID=SBSB.SBSB_ID
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID = 'INMCDWP0'
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE
            ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK
               AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'
               AND SYSDATE BETWEEN MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE_TERM_DT
               AND MEPE.CSCS_ID LIKE 'CH%'
               AND MEPE.GRGR_CK = 90
         JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBP_BILL_PER BLBP
            ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLBP.SBSB_CK AND BLBP.BLBP_VOID_IND = 'N' 
               AND SYSDATE BETWEEN BLBP.BLBP_EFF_DT AND BLBP.BLBP_TERM_DT
         JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI
            ON     SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK
               AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'
         JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLE1
            ON     BLBP.BLBP_CK = BLE1.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK
               AND BLE1.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'J'
       )TA
           ON (TA.SUBSCRIBERID=RCP.SBSB_ID)
         WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
         RCP.GRGR_ID = TA.GROUPID,
        RCP.REFUND_BILLINGLEVEL = TA.REFUND_BILLINGLEVEL;
END;

BEGIN
MERGE INTO AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP RCP 
USING ( SELECT  /*+ optimizer_features_enable('11.2.0.3') */ DISTINCT R.PAYMENT_TYPE,SBSB.SBSB_ID AS SUBSCRIBERID, GRGR.GRGR_ID AS GROUPID,
             CASE WHEN SBSB.SBSB_CK = PER.SBSB_CK AND R.PAYMENT_TYPE = 'W' THEN MAX(PER.BLBP_BILL_PER) END AS REFUND_BILLINGLEVEL
        FROM AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP  R 
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON R.SBSB_ID=SBSB.SBSB_ID 
        LEFT JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBP_BILL_PER PER ON SBSB.SBSB_CK= PER.SBSB_CK AND SBSB.GRGR_CK = PER.GRGR_CK   
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK 
        AND GRGR.GRGR_ID = 'INMCDWP0'
        WHERE SBSB.SBSB_ID NOT IN (SELECT  SBSB_ID FROM (SELECT DISTINCT R.SBSB_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT GRGR.GRGR_CK) OVER (PARTITION BY SBSB.SBSB_ID ) AS  CNT 
                                      FROM  AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP R 
                                      JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON R.SBSB_ID=SBSB.SBSB_ID  AND R.GRGR_ID IS NULL
                                      LEFT JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBP_BILL_PER PER ON SBSB.SBSB_CK= PER.SBSB_CK  AND SBSB.GRGR_CK = PER.GRGR_CK
                                      JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK  AND GRGR.GRGR_ID = 'INMCDWP0' 
                                      ) A WHERE CNT > 1)
         GROUP BY  PER.SBSB_CK,SBSB.SBSB_CK,SBSB.SBSB_ID,GRGR.GRGR_ID,R.PAYMENT_TYPE 
         
        UNION 
        
        SELECT DISTINCT  R.PAYMENT_TYPE,SBSB.SBSB_ID AS SUBSCRIBERID, GRGR.GRGR_ID AS GROUPID,0 AS REFUND_BILLINGLEVEL
        FROM  AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP R
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON R.SBSB_ID=SBSB.SBSB_ID 
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK  AND GRGR.GRGR_ID ='KYMCDWP0'
        WHERE SBSB.SBSB_ID NOT IN (SELECT  SBSB_ID FROM (SELECT DISTINCT R.SBSB_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT GRGR.GRGR_CK) OVER (PARTITION BY SBSB.SBSB_ID ) AS  CNT
                                   FROM  AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP R
                                   JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON R.SBSB_ID=SBSB.SBSB_ID 
                                   JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID = 'KYMCDWP0'
                                   ) A WHERE CNT > 1)
                                      
        UNION                              
        
        SELECT DISTINCT R.PAYMENT_TYPE,SBSB.SBSB_ID AS SUBSCRIBERID, GRGR.GRGR_ID AS GROUPID,0 AS REFUND_BILLINGLEVEL
        FROM AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP  R 
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON R.SBSB_ID=SBSB.SBSB_ID    
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK 
        AND (GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%MCRWP0' OR GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%MCR000')
        
        UNION                              
        
        SELECT DISTINCT R.PAYMENT_TYPE,SBSB.SBSB_ID AS SUBSCRIBERID, GRGR.GRGR_ID AS GROUPID,0 AS REFUND_BILLINGLEVEL
        FROM AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP  R 
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON R.SBSB_ID=SBSB.SBSB_ID    
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK 
        AND (GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%EGR%' OR GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%GRS%')
        
      ) TA 
 ON (TA.SUBSCRIBERID=RCP.SBSB_ID AND TA.GROUPID = RCP.GRGR_ID AND TA.PAYMENT_TYPE=RCP.PAYMENT_TYPE) 
 WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE 
 SET ISVALID = 'V',
 RCP.REFUND_BILLINGLEVEL = TA.REFUND_BILLINGLEVEL;

UPDATE AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP SET ISVALID = 'I' WHERE ISVALID IS NULL;
END;

BEGIN
MERGE INTO AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP RCP 
USING (
SELECT  /*+ optimizer_features_enable('11.2.0.3') */ DISTINCT  R.PAYMENT_TYPE,SBSB.SBSB_CK AS SUB_CK, SBSB.SBSB_ID AS SUBSCRIBERID,GRGR.GRGR_ID AS GROUPID,
          CASE WHEN SBSB.SBSB_CK = PER.SBSB_CK AND R.PAYMENT_TYPE = 'P' THEN 'L' END AS PAYMENT_BILLINGLEVEL,
          CASE WHEN SBSB.SBSB_CK = PER.SBSB_CK AND R.PAYMENT_TYPE = 'F' THEN MAX(PER.BLBP_BILL_PER) END AS REFUND_BILLINGLEVEL
      FROM  AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP R 
         JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB  ON R.SBSB_ID=SBSB.SBSB_ID  AND R.GRGR_ID IS NULL
         JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBP_BILL_PER PER ON SBSB.SBSB_CK= PER.SBSB_CK  AND SBSB.GRGR_CK = PER.GRGR_CK
              AND R.RECEIVEDDATE = (SELECT MAX(RECEIVEDDATE) FROM AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP WHERE SBSB_ID = R.SBSB_ID)   
         JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK  AND GRGR.GRGR_ID = 'INMCDWP0' 
         JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK 
         JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK  
              AND R.RECEIVEDDATE BETWEEN LEAST(R.RECEIVEDDATE,MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT) AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
              AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND ='Y'
      WHERE SBSB.SBSB_ID NOT IN (SELECT  SBSB_ID FROM (SELECT DISTINCT R.SBSB_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT GRGR.GRGR_CK) OVER (PARTITION BY SBSB.SBSB_ID ) AS  CNT 
                                      FROM  AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP R 
                                      JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON R.SBSB_ID=SBSB.SBSB_ID  
                                      JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK  
                                      JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK 
                                      JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK  
                                           AND R.RECEIVEDDATE BETWEEN LEAST(R.RECEIVEDDATE,MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT) AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
                                           AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND ='Y') A WHERE CNT > 1)
      GROUP BY  PER.SBSB_CK,SBSB.SBSB_CK,SBSB.SBSB_ID,GRGR.GRGR_ID,R.PAYMENT_TYPE  
        
UNION
 
SELECT DISTINCT  R.PAYMENT_TYPE,SBSB.SBSB_CK AS SUB_CK, SBSB.SBSB_ID AS SUBSCRIBERID,GRGR.GRGR_ID AS GROUPID,'' PAYMENT_BILLINGLEVEL,0   AS REFUND_BILLINGLEVEL
     FROM  AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP R 
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON R.SBSB_ID=SBSB.SBSB_ID  
             AND R.RECEIVEDDATE = (SELECT MAX(RECEIVEDDATE) FROM AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP WHERE SBSB_ID = R.SBSB_ID)   
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK  AND R.GRGR_ID IS NULL
             AND (GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' OR GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%MCR%' OR GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%EGR%' OR GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%PDP%' OR GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%GRS%' OR GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%GRX%')  
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK 
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK  
             AND R.RECEIVEDDATE BETWEEN LEAST(R.RECEIVEDDATE,MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT) AND CASE WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' THEN  MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT + INTERVAL '31' DAY ELSE MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT END
             AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND ='Y' 
     WHERE SBSB.SBSB_ID NOT IN (SELECT  SBSB_ID FROM (SELECT DISTINCT R.SBSB_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT GRGR.GRGR_CK) OVER (PARTITION BY SBSB.SBSB_ID ) AS  CNT 
                                      FROM  AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP R 
                                      JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON R.SBSB_ID=SBSB.SBSB_ID  
                                      JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK  
                                      JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK 
                                      JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK  
                                           AND R.RECEIVEDDATE BETWEEN LEAST(R.RECEIVEDDATE,MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT) AND CASE WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' THEN  MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT + INTERVAL '31' DAY ELSE MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT END
                                           AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND ='Y' 
                                                      ) A WHERE CNT > 1)
UNION

SELECT DISTINCT  R.PAYMENT_TYPE,SBSB.SBSB_CK AS SUB_CK, SBSB.SBSB_ID AS SUBSCRIBERID,GRGR.GRGR_ID AS GROUPID,'' PAYMENT_BILLINGLEVEL,0   AS REFUND_BILLINGLEVEL
     FROM  AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP R 
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON R.SBSB_ID=SBSB.SBSB_ID  
             AND R.RECEIVEDDATE = (SELECT MAX(RECEIVEDDATE) FROM AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP WHERE SBSB_ID = R.SBSB_ID)   
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR 
             ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK  
            AND R.GRGR_ID IS NULL
            AND (GRGR.GRGR_ID IN ('NYMCD000', 'WIMCDWP0'))
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK 
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE 
        ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK  
            AND R.RECEIVEDDATE BETWEEN LEAST(R.RECEIVEDDATE,MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT) AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
            AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND ='Y' 
     WHERE SBSB.SBSB_ID NOT IN (SELECT  SBSB_ID FROM (SELECT DISTINCT R.SBSB_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT GRGR.GRGR_CK) OVER (PARTITION BY SBSB.SBSB_ID ) AS  CNT 
                                      FROM  AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP R 
                                      JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON R.SBSB_ID=SBSB.SBSB_ID  
                                      JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK  
                                      JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK 
                                      JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK  
                                            AND R.RECEIVEDDATE BETWEEN LEAST(R.RECEIVEDDATE,MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT) AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
                                           AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND ='Y') A WHERE CNT > 1)

UNION 
    
    SELECT DISTINCT R.PAYMENT_TYPE,SBSB.SBSB_CK AS SUB_CK,SBSB.SBSB_ID AS SUBSCRIBERID,GRGR.GRGR_ID AS GROUPID,'' PAYMENT_BILLINGLEVEL,0 AS REFUND_BILLINGLEVEL
      FROM AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_GROUP_LOOKUP R 
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON R.SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID AND (R.GRGR_ID IS NULL OR R.GRGR_ID = ' ')
